nodes.title: 系统全景
nodes.summary: Partial document illustrates system landscape: coding infrastructure (self-developed FSC engine, claw-mesh cluster, K8s control via claw-grid linking to Agent ecosystem and deployments). API & routing (ClawAPI, Router v3.0, China MCP gateway). Agent ecosystem with orchestrator oh-my-claudecode connecting to OpenClaw (149 skills), ZeroClaw (Rust), OpenCode. Quant trading stack with quant-terminal, hist-mat engine, AI self-loop. Thought research with hist-mat engine and knowledge board. Cluster infrastructure nodes (Central, Silicon Valley, Tokyo, SUPER, NAS, Curry, interconnections). Memory systems (GitNexus, RAG, MemoV, auto-memory, Obsidian, notepad). Deployment links between components.

nodes.title: 项目索引
nodes.summary: 项目索引涵盖多个领域的主要项目状态概览，包括编码（FSC、claw-mesh等）、路由（ClawAPI、Claw Router等）、Agent系统、量化交易、研究项目、优化工具和集群运维，每个项目标注了当前状态和关键指标。
